name: b6406-scale
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, bright daylight in a sunlit stone courtyard with green date palms. A large old brass balance scale standing on a carved wooden base, no people and no hands. The left pan hangs LOW, clearly weighed down, and is touched by a soft warm golden glow; the right pan rides HIGH and empty. The beam is steeply tipped. Clean composition, the scale centred, a vivid blue sky behind. Even daylight, vibrant saturated colours, calm and solemn, no modern objects, no text.
